reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Soothing Gel 150mL
reviews.text: I really love this moisturizer. It is calming and very light. Perfect for day ware if you have irritated skin. When there is minus degrees (Celsius)outside, i avoid using it, but except form that I use it every day.
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢款保濕霜。鎮靜又輕盈。如果皮膚受刺激，日頭用就一流。出面零下嘅時候我會避免用，但除此之外我日日都用。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Soothing Gel 150mL
reviews.text: You guys, I’ve been really into the ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Soothing Gel (150 mL) lately! 😍 It’s become such a staple in my routine because it keeps my skin feeling so hydrated and refreshed without feeling heavy or sticky. The gel texture just melts in and gives this dewy, healthy glow that I love — perfect for layering under makeup or using after a long day. 🌿💧 It’s super soothing too, especially on days my skin feels sensitive. Honestly, such a good find! 🫶🏽
reviews.zh: 大家，我最近真係勁鍾意 ROUND LAB 樺樹汁保濕舒緩 Gel (150 mL)！😍 已經成為我日常必備，保濕又清爽，唔會厚重或者黏笠。Gel 狀質地一抹就推開，俾到我鍾意嘅水光感同健康光澤——底妝之前用或者攰到爆嘅一日之後用都一流。🌿💧 舒緩效果都超勁，特別係皮膚敏感嘅日子。講真，搵到寶！🫶🏽

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Soothing Gel 150mL
reviews.text: My favorite gel moisturizer. Not too thick or too watery. I’ve ordered this 3 times now. Great for places where it’s not as cold and drying like where I live. But love to keep my fave moisturized. I don’t think it has spf or anything so I can’t say about sun protection but since I really like this moisturizer I’ll give it a 5? lol just to boost it hahah
reviews.zh: 我最鍾意嘅 Gel 保濕霜。唔會太稠亦唔會太稀。已經回購第 3 次。適合好似我住嘅地方咁唔算太凍太乾嘅地方用。但都好鍾意 keep 住皮膚保濕。應該冇 SPF 咁，所以防晒方面就唔評論，但因為真係好鍾意呢款保濕霜所以俾 5 星？lol 純粹撐下 hahah

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Soothing Gel 150mL
reviews.text: My go to moisturizer especially during the summer. I live on island so creams are too heavy and I have combination skin but using this balances it. I only use creams when I travel during the winter. This feels so nice especially when it’s cold. Also a little goes a long way, or for me that is hahah idk about sun protection. I mean I use the same brand sun screen stick, but about this moisturizer idk if it has sun protection hahaha. I make sure it’s near my door so o don’t forget lol
reviews.zh: 我夏天必用嘅保濕品。我住喺島上面，所以霜狀對我嚟講太厚重，而且我係混合性肌，用咗呢個就平衡到。我淨係冬天去旅行先用霜。呢個用落感覺好好，尤其係凍嘅時候。仲有少少已經夠用一大片，對我嚟講係咁啦哈哈哈，我唔知有冇防曬功效。我意思係我用同一個品牌嘅防曬棒，但呢款保濕品我就唔知有冇防曬功效哈哈哈。我會擺佢喺門口，等自己唔好忘記 lol

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Soothing Gel 150mL
reviews.text: I use this product when my skin is irritated by sun. I keep this in refrigerator and when it’s cool, it’s so nice on skin as it calms the red skin. It absorbs really quickly and leaves no grease. Perfect for summer!
reviews.zh: 我皮膚畀太陽曬到敏感嘅時候就用呢個產品。我會擺佢入雪櫃，雪凍咗之後搽上面超舒服，可以舒緩泛紅。吸收得好快，唔會油笠笠。夏天必備！

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Soothing Gel 150mL
reviews.text: I actually really like this product more than I thought I would. It is a really nice lightweight moisturizer for the summer, but I would say it's not very hydrating. I stored it in the fridge as it said and it is very cooling. It doesn't have any sun protection, so I don't know why that's an option.
reviews.zh: 我以為自己唔會鍾意呢個產品，但點知我幾鍾意佢。佢係一款好輕盈嘅夏天保濕品，但我要話佢唔算好保濕。我跟住指示擺咗佢入雪櫃，用落真係好涼爽。佢冇防曬功能，所以唔知點解會有呢個選項。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Soothing Gel 150mL
reviews.text: Honestly this product did nothing for my skin. I wanted to like it based off all the hype but it left my skib somehow feeling drier than when I put it on. It seems to work ok for ny boyfriend who has oily skin type, but if you have dry skin I'd say to just skip this product.
reviews.zh: 講真呢個產品對我皮膚完全冇用。本來睇住大家都讚都想鍾意佢，但搽完之後皮膚竟然仲乾過未搽之前。對我個男朋友（油性肌）好似 work 喎，但如果你係乾性肌，我會建議直接跳過呢款產品。

reviews.shade: ROUND LAB Birch Juice Moisturizing Soothing Gel 150mL
reviews.text: I've bought quite a few of round lab's products and they've all been a hit. This moisturizer is great for sensitive skin as it's pretty gentle and doesn't have any fragrances. There's also just a lot of great ingredients in this, so a huge recommend.
reviews.zh: 我買咗唔少 round lab 嘅產品，每隻都好啱用。呢款保濕品好啱敏感肌，因為好溫和又冇香料。仲有好多好成分，大力推薦。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
